title: Drop tables, version 1
description: A file under content/drops/ (work order 007, scope 1, with Jeremy's answers to its Q1 and Q6). 'id' is drops.<zone>.<name>, zone one of rustmoor, cinderworks, thunderhead, global. 'tables' holds the drop tables, one per monster. Each table names a monster id; crowns, {min, max}, the Crowns paid per kill, integers with min >= 0 and max >= min; entries, a list of {item, chance, qty_min, qty_max}, each rolled independently per kill, with 0 < chance <= 1 and integer quantities qty_min >= 1 and qty_max >= qty_min; and first_kill, a list of item ids given once, on the player's first kill (bosses only). 'zone_pity' is an ORDERED list of {item, kills} on ONE shared pity timer (GDD section 5): the game keeps a single counter per zone, advanced by any kill of any monster in the zone, and delivers the listed items in list order, each guaranteed within its 'kills' on that counter; each item must be one a non-boss table in this file drops. first_kill may hold non-page items, which may also be in the same table's entries. The orderings, 'bosses only', 'one per monster', the zone_pity rule, whether each named monster and item exists, and the Ledger Page rules are checked in code (the drops and references checks), not here. 'revision' is optional and exists only so a register row's revision can match the file.
